title: Twelve dots, three ways
summary: The same twelve dots regroup as 3 rows of 4, 2 rows of 6 and 1 row of 12, so the total stays 12.
source: The kit's sample code scene, written by hand for kits/manim (animations/sample-dots.py). hold_ms = 900 + 28 per character of the step's words.

steps.t: The same dots move into 2 rows of 6.
And into 1 row of 12: each arrangement still holds 12.
